_readme: Atharva Sangeet catalog. Only add recordings Epsilonpi Limited owns or has licensed in writing. Every track needs 'rights' (owned | commissioned | licensed) or the app ignores it. To pull a track from every phone, delete it from this list (or set hidden: true). To replace a recording, upload the new file and bump 'version'. Suno tracks are 'licensed': only songs made while on a paid Suno plan can be used commercially.

tracks.title: Om Tryambakam Yajamahe
tracks.subtitle: Mahamrityunjaya Mantra · Shiva
tracks.credits: Mantra: Rig Veda 7.59.12 · Music made with Suno
lyrics: ॐ त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे
सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम्
उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान्
मृत्योर्मुक्षीय माऽमृतात्
Om Tryambakam Yajamahe
Sugandhim Pushtivardhanam
Urvarukamiva Bandhanan
Mrityor Mukshiya Maamritat
We worship the three-eyed Lord Shiva, fragrant, who nourishes all.
As the ripe cucumber is freed from its vine, may He free us from death — and not from immortality.

lyrics: Sit comfortably and let your shoulders drop.
Breathe in slowly… and out.
With each bowl, let one thought go.
Breathe in — ॐ
Breathe out — शान्ति
Rest in the sound until it fades.
